_comment: Single map of models this deployment knows about. Product authority is
still only llm-profiles.json + gatePassed. This file answers: what exists,
where it runs, whether Cortex needs it. It does not pull or enable models.

live.ollama: up at :11434 — 10 tags (7 pulled + 3 locally built micro-extract measurement tags)

unify.evalAndLiveJudge: ollama loopback for calibration and quality benches
unify.cpu: forbidden by DevicePolicy unless opted in
unify.doNotUnifyIntoOneServer: OVMS owns NPU/GPU IR; Ollama owns GGUF. Same LlmProfile schema, two runtimes. Do not serve the product embedder on both.

fineTune.microExtractTrainSplit: corpora/micro-extract-train.jsonl — split=train only; split=holdout rows are the eval gold and must never be trained on
fineTune.pipeline: scripts/fine-tune/ (training-only Python; not a product runtime)
fineTune.source: cortex-original only — no Superpowers SKILL.md bodies

roles.micro_extract: Qwen3-0.6B LoRA trained 2026-08-15; passes the extraction gate on Ollama/GGUF-f16, not on the OVMS/NPU INT4 tuple the profile names

models.note: Product embedder. OVMS INT8 IR, pooling LAST.
